{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows increasing negativity.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 1-2 day lag correction.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when sentiment > 0.50 — especially in early horizon (1-3 days).",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, reduce volatility bias when sentiment is stable (sentiment < 0.25).",
    "Correct for overconfidence in upward trends: if forecast > 15% above prior 15-day high, cap at 10% above.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending down, apply a downward bias of 2-5% to prevent reversal misjudgment."
  ]
}
